column1: # Coordinate keys and bit fields as the builder's functions give them (builder/src/coord_keys.h),
# which the builder's tests and the server's (server/src/coord_keys.rs) both check. A row is a
# kind, what goes in and what comes out; - stands for nothing:
#   key       an f32 bit pattern (hex): its order key and its hybrid key (hex; - when it has none)
#   hybrid    a u32 (hex): the pattern it is the hybrid key of (hex; - when it is no pattern's)
#   length    a u32 (hex): its bit length and its byte length
#   bits      fields, value:width each (hex:decimal): the bytes they pack to, LSB first, the
#             last byte filled with zero bits (hex)
#   varint    a u64 (decimal): its LEB128 bytes (hex)
#   novarint  bytes (hex): a limit; no varint of at most that many bytes, in its fewest, starts them
#   dec4      an f32 bit pattern (hex): its decimal key (decimal; - when it has none) and its
#   undec4    an i32 (decimal): the pattern it decodes to as a decimal key (hex)
#   rice      codes, z:k each (hex:decimal): the bytes they pack to, LSB first, the last byte
#   ricek     values (hex; - for none): the least Rice parameter of the fewest bits, and the bits
# Each also holds backwards: a key gives its pattern, a zigzag its difference, the bytes their
# fields, codes and their number. Regenerate with geocoder/testdata/gen_coord_vectors.cpp.
